text: Relieved that Dad's scan came back clear this week. At the same time I still feel the knot in my stomach about the mortgage and how tense everyone gets when money comes up. Trying to hold both things honestly.

text: Thinking about Mom as she starts chemo on Monday. Hoping she finds real strength and peace. Dad keeps acting practical when really he's terrified. And my brother Evan keeps joking about everything because he doesn't want anyone to see how scared he is.

text: I don't know how to process the miscarriage without feeling numb or angry. People keep saying they're sorry, and I know they mean well, but every gentle sentence somehow makes the silence louder. I just need space to sit with the part of grief that feels empty and embarrassed and tired.
summary: Grieving a miscarriage; raw pain, numbness, anger; needing space without platitudes

text: I need to admit I was crueler than I wanted to be yesterday. I was gossiping about Lena because I wanted other people to agree with me. If I need to call her and own what I said, I want the courage to do it plainly without making excuses.
summary: Regret over gossiping about Lena; wanting courage to make amends

text: The credit card bill is sitting on the counter like a threat and I can already feel both Marcus and me rehearsing our sides. Need to find a way to talk about money without making each other the villain. Also want to apologize for the sarcastic comment I made last night.
